Airbnb, or a long-term tenant? Same house, two very different jobs.

Long-term: a lease, about the same rent every month. Simple, usually less money.

Short-term: guests pay more per night, but income swings with the seasons, and you pay for cleaning, furniture and supplies. Many cities limit short-term rentals, so check the rules first.
